title: Daily Devotional #34
paragraphs: Today I read Mark 6 and was struck by the way Jesus interacted with the people around him. In this chapter, we see Jesus teaching in his hometown of Nazareth, sending out his disciples to preach and heal, feeding the 5,000, and walking on water.

As I read, I was reminded of how powerful and compassionate you are. You have the ability to heal the sick, feed the hungry, and calm the storms of life. You are not limited by our circumstances, and you can do far more than we could ever imagine.

But I was also struck by how the people around Jesus responded to him. In Nazareth, the people were skeptical of Jesus and did not believe in his power. They were so focused on their own perceptions of him that they missed out on the miracles he could have done for them.

On the other hand, the crowds who followed Jesus were eager to receive his teaching and healing. They recognized him as someone special and were willing to follow him wherever he went. Even when Jesus withdrew to a quiet place, they followed him there, hungry for more of his words and presence.

Lord, I pray that I would be like those who followed Jesus, eager to learn from him and be in his presence. Help me to recognize your power and trust in you, even when things seem impossible. And help me to avoid being like those in Nazareth, who doubted and missed out on your blessings.

Thank you for your endless grace and mercy, and for the many ways you show your love to us each day. May we never take your goodness for granted, but always seek to honor and serve you in all that we do.
